criterion.description: K18 (A18/S18) – Dialog und Logs über Session/Queue korrekt korrelieren, Authentisierung von Absenderberechtigung unterscheiden, begründete Reaktion mit weiterer Klärung sowie Risiken des Klartextdiensts und der Logdaten erläutern. Ein Punkt nur bei insgesamt fachlich tragfähiger vollständiger zugeordneter Kompetenzleistung; bei fehlender oder wesentlich unvollständiger Leistung null Punkte.

cases.sourceContextDelta: Only 6c4.requires changes from SMTP/POP3 mastery to the existing motivational introduction. Its identity, DE/EN competence, parents, scope and assessment coverage remain unchanged. Historical f95 draft source pins and the original independent review pins remain history; no hash is replaced.
cases.materialRead: Entire M2 SMTP dialogue, explicit AUTH PLAIN format explanation and five log lines; A03 protocol analysis; A18 authentication/log correlation; complete S18 and the separate one-point criterion.
cases.judgment: M2 makes the service events and logs observable. A18/S18 independently demand session/queue correlation, authentication versus sender permission, a justified response requiring further verification, cleartext and log-data risks, and limits of attack/identity/delivery inferences. This still covers the full unchanged 6c4 goal. SMTP analysis remains a separate A03 criterion in both exams. Sharing this material is no evidence for a universal SMTP prerequisite to learning authentication/log reflection.
cases.bounds: No new complete exam review or reference execution. E25 remains its own 25-result contract; GK24 remains its own unapplied draft. The changed whole-goal context needs this separate addendum and later integration guards, not rewriting either original review.
